rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a device used to heat a room.

example.english: This heater warms the room up pretty quickly.
example.traditional: 呢部暖爐幾快就令間房暖返。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 nyun5 lou4 gei2 faai3 zau6 ling6 gaan1 fong2 nyun5 faan1

rows.note: Use this when you want to specify that the room heater is electric.

example.english: We turn on the electric heater in the morning, and the whole room gets warm right away.
example.traditional: 朝早開住部電暖爐，成間房即刻暖晒。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 hoi1 zyu6 bou6 din6 nyun5 lou4 seng4 gaan1 fong2 zik1 hak1 nyun5 saai3
